quotes.en: Annoying to have to change it every time I fight.

advice.text: (comment) For Conquest drop crit resistance and put HP on the bottom-left items; bottom-right is haste + damage reduction.

damage.text: (comment) Replacing crit resistance with HP keeps everyone alive to the 5 s mark (likely 5 s remaining on the timer), lengthening damage time.

advice.text: (comment) Crumble level EXP rate scales with your stage; time spent at a high stage, not the lucky dice, drives it.

quotes.en: (comment) The higher the stage, the faster Crumble EXP rises.

posts.title_en: Do you skip crit resistance entirely for Conquest?
posts.summary_en: Screenshot of the same +15 Eternal helmet: with damage reduction 6.50% + crit resistance 21.43% it shows 336.65M power; the alternative with damage reduction 6.76% + HP +10,079 shows 228.64M (−108M). A commenter says crit resistance is a dead line in Conquest because the boss doesn't crit and Conquest has no power correction (stages do), and the same holds for the Crumble Dungeon.

datapoints.account: kind not stated (item power on gear screen)
datapoints.before: helmet subs dmg reduction 6.50% + crit resistance 21.43%: 336.65M
datapoints.note: crit resistance sub inflates displayed power far more than HP

advice.text: (comment) Drop crit resistance for Conquest and Crumble Dungeon; take HP instead even though displayed power falls.

damage.text: (comment) Crit resistance does nothing in Conquest: the boss doesn't crit, and Conquest has no power-based correction; on stages it at least feeds the power correction.
(comment) Same for the Crumble Dungeon: crit resistance is a wasted line.
(comment) On stages crit resistance raises power, which feeds the stage power correction.

quotes.kr: 토벌보스가 치명타로 안때리니 옵션 자체가 잉여옵. 스테이지면 투력보정이라도 있지만 토벌은 투력보정도 없음
quotes.en: (comment) The Conquest boss doesn't hit with crits, so the line is wasted; stages at least have a power correction, Conquest has none.
Power drops by 100m; is HP really right?

damage.text: Changing perks and cookie levels for Conquest leaves the Arena defence weaker meanwhile; players accept losses (revenge exists).

damage.text: (comment) Skill-haste gear beats displayed-power (crit resistance) gear for actually clearing stages at a given %.

posts.title_en: Stage tips after clearing every map at 15%
posts.summary_en: Guide. Screenshot at stage 352-8: team power 4G 881M 210K (preset '건실스테'), blessing Lv.6, cookies Lv.118 (one 115), oven Lv.39, plates mostly +15 with two +17 and one +10. Gear: 6 skill dmg, 4 crit dmg, 2 hit on top; 5 dmg reduction, 3 haste, 3 crit resistance, 1 concentration below; maximise crit dmg × crit rate. Perk card fixed at 720; Battery pet except on airborne maps (lucky pouch). Commenters: crit resistance only for padding power; Battery makes Strawberry Crepe 1.6× stronger; swapping a hit item for a hit pet would be ~4% damage.

datapoints.account: stage 352-8; team 4G 881M 210K (team power, stage preset on screen); blessing Lv.6
datapoints.after: cookies Lv.118; oven Lv.39; plates +15 with +17 on two and +10 on one

advice.text: 15% stage set: 6 skill dmg / 4 crit dmg / 2 hit top, 5 dmg reduction / 3 haste / 3 crit res / 1 concentration bottom; choose crit dmg vs rate to maximise their product.

Perk card fixed at 720.
Battery pet except on airborne maps, where the lucky pouch goes in.

damage.text: (poster's reply) Battery pet makes Strawberry Crepe 1.6× stronger; replacing a hit gear line with a hit pet estimated at ~4% damage.
Dark Choco adds damage in the tens of percent but is skipped because its defence shred doesn't always apply; power is irrelevant so Devil cookie recommended.

quotes.en: Crit dmg × crit rate should be as high as possible.
(poster's reply) Strawberry Crepe gets 1.6× stronger from the Battery.
(poster's reply) Crit resistance is for power padding; skip it if you have power to spare.
